instruction: Please activate battery saver mode to extend my laptop's battery life.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible in the OSWorld VM environment. Battery saver mode and power management features are hardware-dependent and require actual battery hardware to function and verify. VMs do not have physical batteries and cannot meaningfully activate or verify battery saver modes.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - battery saver mode requires physical battery hardware that does not exist in VM environments
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for hardware-dependent tasks that cannot be tested in VMs
Metadata explanation clearly and accurately describes why this task cannot be completed or verified
No semantic or logical issues - this is the correct way to handle tasks that are physically impossible to verify in the test environment
